name: exists_subalgebra_of_fg
statement: (⊤ : Subalgebra A C).FG) (hBC : (⊤ : Submodule B C).FG) : ∃ B₀ : Subalgebra A B, B₀.FG ∧ (⊤ : Submodule B₀ C).FG

name: fg_of_fg_of_fg
statement: (⊤ : Subalgebra A C).FG) (hBC : (⊤ : Submodule B C).FG) (hBCi : Function.Injective (algebraMap B C)) : (⊤ : Subalgebra A B).FG
